turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm doing a horror marathon on Halloween. How many films is reasonable?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Three is a good number. Four if you start early and have plenty of snacks.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Unrelated, but I want to take a photography class this autumn but I can't decide which.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me describe everything first, and then I'll ask for your thoughts.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A ten week evening course at the community college, with homework and critique every week.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A weekend workshop in the mountains, two full days of shooting landscapes with a pro.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: An online course I can do whenever, with videos and a forum, really cheap.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A street photography walk group that meets every Saturday morning, free, but no real teaching.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that's all of them. What do you think?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It depends what you're missing. Skills and feedback, take the college course. Motivation and company, the free Saturday group is great, and you could pair it with the cheap online course for the theory.
